title: A simple colorimetric sensor based on a new deep eutectic solvent for the detection of chromium
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22641-22648
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02492G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thanaporn Seesuan, Nutthaya Butwong, Supalax Srijaranai, Siriboon Mukdasai
A sensitive colorimetric sensor for Cr6+ was developed using a DES probe (TBABr/AA/EDTA). Cr6+ was reduced to Cr3+ by AA, then formed a purple complex with EDTA, which was quantified by UV-vis spectrophotometry and smartphone detection.
